description:
[read-only] Lead status counts (new, contacted, unreachable, qualified, converted, disqualified) and the total for the brand's selected Meta account, read live. Optional campaignId (digits) counts one campaign's leads. No lead details.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/leads/counts.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_lead_counts
title: Count leads by status
